Chapter 1154: Chapter 18 Comprehensive Enhancement (Request Subscription)

“The Eye of Myriad Laws says that a Heart Demon exists within Xuanhuang, and the Moyu Tower Master says Xuanhuang is striving for the Thirteen Tiers to resurrect a companion?”

Lin Yuan thought silently.

From the Moyu Tower Master’s tone, Xuanhuang should also be an existence not weaker than him.

“Alright, my time here is limited.”

The Moyu Tower Master smiled and then flipped his hand.

The Six-Armed Figure Shen Ji was then moved to the Ninth Layer.

“Master.”

The Six-Armed Figure Shen Ji was moved to tears with excitement.

Earlier outside the Black Tower, upon seeing the Moyu Tower Master reviving consciousness, he was somewhat stunned. The master he had been waiting for many Cosmic Eras without returning was now appearing on the Ninth Layer?

“From today onward, he will be the new Tower Master of Demonic Jade Tower.”

The Moyu Tower Master looked at the Six-Armed Figure Shen Ji and spoke.

“Yes.”

The Six-Armed Figure Shen Ji nodded immediately.

The hierarchy within Demonic Jade Tower is strict; not to mention becoming the new Tower Master, even to become a Direct Disciple requires personal approval from the Moyu Tower Master.

It is precisely for this reason that Lin Yuan is currently just a sequenced member of the Demonic Jade Tower, which is already the limit.

However, now.

A consciousness left by the Moyu Tower Master has revived, equivalent to the Moyu Tower Master personally arriving.

“Back in the day, I left some good things in this Demon Jade Space; if you don’t become the Tower Master, you can only choose a few.” The Moyu Tower Master looked at Lin Yuan, smiling.

“Thank you, senior.” Lin Yuan spoke with a grateful tone.

According to the rules of Demonic Jade Tower, every time one passes a layer, they can only choose from the reward list.

No matter how astonishingly talented Lin Yuan’s performance is, he cannot break this rule.

But becoming the Tower Master is different. With the personal approval of the Moyu Tower Master, Lin Yuan has the highest control privileges over this Demon Jade Space.

He can freely dispose of all treasures and wonders within the Demon Jade Space.

The control privileges of being a sequenced member before, compared with the current Tower Master privileges, are just like child’s play.

“That drop of Time’s Blood, you must carefully comprehend.” The Moyu Tower Master admonished.

After reviving consciousness, he was fully aware and in control of everything happening in this Demon Jade Space.

“Yes.” Lin Yuan nodded.

All these years, he had never stopped comprehending that drop of Time’s Blood; the more he understands, the more he can feel the vast incredibility between different timelines.

It was like a fish growing in the deep sea, looking up through layers of seawater, gazing at the boundless starry sky.

Although extremely blurry, it could still capture the vastness of the endless starry sky.

“The Thirteen-Tier inheritance I cultivated cannot be left to you, nor can I even tell you how to obtain it.” The Moyu Tower Master pondered for a moment before speaking.

“Understood.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

The Thirteen-Tier inheritance left by the time life focuses most on opportunities.

Which implies that the means of acquisition must not have any deliberate preparation, like Lin Yuan obtaining the Jade Gourd purely by coincidence, without knowing in advance.

Other Thirteen-Tier inheritances are the same; if one knows the location of this Thirteen-Tier inheritance from other sources and then pretends to obtain it deliberately…

One would face retribution from the creator of that inheritance afterward.

Don’t think about deceiving a Thirteen Tier; life at this level can observe along the timeline, knowing almost anything they wish to know.

If one dares to touch the bottom line set by Thirteen Tier, even if you die, you could be forcibly resurrected and then live worse than death.

“As long as you understand.”

The Moyu Tower Master’s figure began to faintly fade, with strands of time’s power beginning to shroud around him.

“I am about to be drawn into a time loop.” The Moyu Tower Master said, this being the result of maximum isolation, only held off by the barrier of Demon Jade Space till now.

If in the Chaos Void, the Moyu Tower Master would be pulled back into the time loop at the instant of consciousness revival.

“Senior, what can I do for you?”

Seeing this, Lin Yuan immediately spoke.

“What can you do for me?” The Moyu Tower Master looked at Lin Yuan, a smile emerging on his face. “Become strong, become as strong as possible, preferably crossing into the Thirteen Tier, becoming Time’s Life.”

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan nodded solemnly.

With the information about striving for Thirteen Tiers and time loops transmitted to him by the Moyu Tower Master, Lin Yuan understands what this sentence means.

What is a time loop?

It is an endless cycle within a period, from beginning to end and then from end to beginning again.

For instance, the Thirteen Tier born from a phenomenal life, caught in a time loop, is embodied in leading an ant tribe and becoming the strongest group of the era.

If this phenomenal life fails and does not achieve this before the lifespan limit, they will be wiped clear and start anew.

At this time, connection with the outside world becomes crucial, helping one recognize reality, spreading the path of evolution, primarily using the latter as ‘anchor points’ and ‘landmarks’ to enhance one’s clear cognition within the time loop.

The evolution path is like this, and cause and effect can serve similar purposes,

However, to break through the barrier of time loop with cause and effect, it must at least be the cause and effect of a Thirteen Tier life, and need to be that significant cause and effect.

Lin Yuan entered Demon Jade Space from weak childhood, established cause and effect with the Moyu Tower Master, and now has become the new Tower Master.

If one could become a time life form, the unprecedented strengthening of cause and effect might help the Magic Jade Tower Master embroiled in a time loop.

Buzz.

Under Lin Yuan’s gaze, the timeline around the Magic Jade Tower Master became increasingly distinct, swiftly dragging him into the void.

“What kind of existence is a time loop really?” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

…

“Master…” Six-Armed Figure Shen Ji was forlorn for a moment before he respectfully saluted Lin Yuan.

Prior to this, even though Lin Yuan had become a sequence member, Six-Armed Figure Shen Ji treated him as an equal.

“There’s no need for such formalities between us.”

Lin Yuan shook his head and immediately began examining the various magical treasures within the Demon Jade Space.

The Magic Jade Tower Master summoned Six-Armed Figure Shen Ji only to notify him, having already transferred the highest authority of the Demon Jade Space to Lin Yuan.

“Demonic Jade Immortal Body?”

Lin Yuan glanced at this body-refining technique created by the Magic Jade Tower Master, no weaker than “Body of Xuanhuang.”

Earlier, when Lin Yuan observed the body segment of a Twelfth Layer member of the Magic Jade Tower, he understood part of the Demonic Jade Immortal Body from it.

Now, he finally obtained the complete Demonic Jade Immortal Body.

“It is entirely different from ‘Body of Xuanhuang.’

Lin Yuan thought to himself, given his current level of insight, comprehending this body-refining technique was not difficult, and he even compared it to “Body of Xuanhuang.”

“Treasures….. magical wonders…” Lin Yuan cursorily scanned them.

The value of the treasures in the Demon Jade Space does not compare to the Xuanhuang Universe, which is expected as they are fundamentally different entities.

The Demon Jade Space is solely a place for nurturing members of the Magic Jade Tower, while the Xuanhuang Universe is a realm painstakingly created by Xuanhuang.

“Is this… the memory of the Magic Jade Tower Master’s killed spectacular life form?” Lin Yuan looked at a piece of Crystal Stone.

This Crystal Stone, like the one storing a drop of Time Blood, possesses an astonishing sealing effect. However, rather than Time Blood, it contains mist resembling a river.

Upon fully mastering the Demon Jade Space, Lin Yuan instantly became aware of the purpose within the mist of the Crystal Stone.

Back then, after the Magic Jade Tower Master, together with other beings of equal rank, managed to kill that time-blood-entrenched spectacular life form, they seized its body.

As for the life essence and soul of that spectacular life form… it’s the river-like mist inside the Crystal Stone, refined through the Magic Jade Tower Master’s special methods. By dedicating part of the mind to exploring it, one can witness the memory perspective of this remarkable life form, including its mastery over time forces.

Though this method doesn’t match the Ancestor of Fierce Sun’s possession in the source world, it remains one of the few ways within Chaos Void to experience the minute timeline perspective.

The time-blood-entrenched spectacular life form had various astonishing techniques, even able to peer into obscure timelines.

The Magic Jade Tower Master and other Great Saints paid a grand price to slay this remarkable life form, but reaped vast rewards.

By studying the Time Blood, the Magic Jade Tower Master fulfilled the cultivation prerequisite for certain Thirteenth Layer inheritance, significantly boosting his power, elevating him to become an Invincible Great Saint of that era.

“That spectacular life form…”

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head. One must admit, the Magic Jade Tower Master and the other Great Saints thoroughly utilized that spectacular life form, from body to life essence and soul.

…

Xuanhuang Universe.

Lin Yuan had fully entered its inner regions.

“The harvest is immense.”

Lin Yuan was delighted, holding the cosmic map of Xuanhuang Universe, his advantage over other Great Saints was substantial.

Many regions within the Xuanhuang Universe appeared ordinary on the surface, such as the Life Origin Star Lin Yuan first encountered.

Who could have imagined it was nurturing a Life Divine Stone nearly three meters high?

A Chaos Great Saint, passing by that Life Origin Star, would generally not spare it a glance.

After all, such planets are too abundant within the Xuanhuang Universe. To inspect each one meticulously, the Chaos Great Saint would lag behind other noble beings in speed.

Only Lin Yuan, leveraging the advantage of the map, was certain of treasures within this region, prompting him to pause and retrieve them.

Apart from the Life Origin Star, many other regions followed suit.

Thus far, those Chaos Great Saints have gained lamentably little.

Only regions that seem particularly extraordinary on the surface would make these Great Saints hesitate.

Yet often these regions harbor traps, like the Futu Tower, or the Nine Realms Pavilion.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan was about to proceed further along his route toward the deeper universe when his expression subtly changed.

“Inner Universe… ‘Infinite Void’ Second Layer has been achieved?”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face. Since fusing with and devouring the source of Fierce Sun, Lin Yuan never halted his cultivation of the Second Layer of ‘Infinite Void.’

Even during his exploration of Xuanhuang Universe, Lin Yuan diverted part of his mind to focus on cultivating the Second Layer of ‘Infinite Void.’

After all, this Thirteenth Layer inheritance is crucial to Lin Yuan, as stepping into the Second Layer would bring another significant qualitative提升.

“The Second Layer of ‘Infinite Void’…”

Lin Yuan immediately descended a consciousness avatar into the inner universe.
